rules.statement: Where a security bond hypothecating immovable property was executed without notarial attestation, the informality does not relieve the obligor of his personal obligation under the bond.
rules.supporting_quote: The fact that the bond is not notarially attested does not render the whole bond invalid. See Halsbury's Laws of England, vol. VII., p. 682; Sidambaram Chetty v . Jayawardana.
